summary: Round r1 (restricted network; data hosts blocked; one WebSearch used for 06C). All empirical items are PENDING. Q1 (strategic road network length and condition) depends on Department of Roads SSRN statistics (lead, general-knowledge URL) with ADB/World Bank transport assessments as cross-checks; local roads are kept separate because of post-2017 jurisdiction changes. Q2 (door-to-port time and cost to Kolkata/Haldia and Visakhapatnam) is set up as an inland-leg decomposition aligned with 05C and 21B, using NIRTTP project documents, ICRIER, NITDB dry-port data and LPI (survey-based; kept separate from transaction-based times). Q3 (railway links) is set up as a stage register for six links, populated only from official sources; the reported 2026 Kolkata-Biratnagar rail cargo start is an unverified press pointer. The reported 2026 flood damage to Trishuli-basin infrastructure (Rasuwagadhi-Kerung corridor) is recorded as an unverified event without numbers. 24 source leads (18 reused from the shared register or source catalog, 6 with general-knowledge URLs flagged unverified).

findings.claim: Q1: Strategic Road Network (SRN) length by pavement type (blacktopped, gravel, earthen) and by province, latest SSRN edition and prior editions (trend).
findings.note: DoR SSRN statistics are the primary source; ADB/WB transport assessments as cross-check. Lengths are recorded in kilometres in the source; units.py has no length unit code, so values will be stored per link-class and flagged (see data_gaps); the finding unit here is the count of SRN links/highways until a length unit exists. Leads: 06A-L01, 06A-L10, 06A-L11
findings.period: latest SSRN edition (Nepal FY) and earlier editions

findings.claim: Q1: SRN condition distribution (good/fair/poor/bad share of network length) and measurement method (IRI survey vs visual).
findings.note: Record condition method and survey year; do not splice IRI-based and visual classes. Leads: 06A-L01, 06A-L10

findings.claim: Q1: Local road network (provincial and local-level roads) length and surface type after federalisation.
findings.note: Local roads moved to provincial/local jurisdiction after 2017; inventories (DoLI, provincial ministries) have separate definitions; keep separate from SRN. Leads: 06A-L02

findings.claim: Q1: Bridge inventory on SRN (count, condition, bridges under construction/stalled).
findings.note: DoR bridge statistics; stalled bridge contracts link to 06C lag distribution. Leads: 06A-L01

findings.claim: Q1: Share of SRN links in high landslide/flood hazard classes and annual count of road-blockage incidents on SRN.
findings.note: GIS overlay of DoR SRN layer with ThinkHazard and BIPAD incidents; method shared with 13A (exposed_assets). Leads: 06A-L01, 06A-L21, 06A-L23

findings.claim: Q2: Door-to-port transit time, Kolkata/Haldia to Birgunj ICD (rail) and to Biratnagar (road; rail since reported 2026 service), import TEU.
findings.note: Transaction-based measures (time-release, NIRTTP monitoring) kept separate from LPI survey-based measures. Leads: 06A-L08, 06A-L09, 06A-L13, 06A-L04, 06A-L16
findings.period: latest available survey year; state calendar vs Nepal FY

findings.claim: Q2: Door-to-port transport cost per TEU on Kolkata/Haldia routes (inland leg: port handling, rail/road haulage, transit documentation, border clearance).
findings.note: Component definitions follow 05C cost_disadvantage_estimates; ocean leg owned by 21B/05C. Leads: 06A-L08, 06A-L13, 06A-L04

findings.claim: Q2: Door-to-port time and cost via Visakhapatnam (rail to Birgunj ICD).
findings.note: Legal basis: letter of exchange to Treaty of Transit (to retrieve). Leads: 06A-L13, 06A-L14, 06A-L04

findings.claim: Q2: Dry-port/ICD throughput by facility (TEU and trucks), Nepal FY series.
findings.note: NITDB annual reports; distinguish rail-borne vs road-borne TEU. Leads: 06A-L04, 06A-L05

findings.claim: Q2: LPI overall score and components for Nepal by edition, and whether Nepal has 2023 KPI (dwell-time) data.
findings.note: LPI 2023 changed methodology; editions are not strictly comparable; survey-based. Leads: 06A-L06, 06A-L07

findings.claim: Q3: Status of announced railway links (Jaynagar-Kurtha-Bijalpura, Jogbani-Biratnagar, Raxaul-Kathmandu, Kerung-Kathmandu, East-West Electric Railway, Kolkata-Biratnagar freight service): stage (concept / feasibility / DPR / financing / construction / operational), financier, last official status date.
findings.note: Official status only from DoRW, MoPIT, PIB/MEA, MoFA; press items recorded as unverified pointers. Leads: 06A-L03, 06A-L15, 06A-L16, 06A-L17

findings.claim: Aviation: airport capacity and utilisation for TIA, Gautam Buddha (Bhairahawa) and Pokhara International airports (passengers and cargo movements).
findings.note: CAAN Civil Aviation Report; cross-check tourism ministry. Leads: 06A-L18

findings.claim: Reported 2026 flood damage to Trishuli-basin transport infrastructure (Rasuwagadhi-Kerung corridor, Pasang Lhamu/Galchhi-Rasuwagadhi road, bridges): UNVERIFIED event; extent, dates and closure duration to be confirmed from DoR, BIPAD, customs border-point data and ICIMOD.
findings.note: No numbers recorded. Not to be used as a scenario calibration point until confirmed by primary records. Leads: 06A-L22, 06A-L23, 06A-L19

findings.claim: 06A-A1: Door-to-port measures use a reference shipment of one import TEU from an East Asian hub to Birgunj ICD, consistent with 21B and 05C.
06A-A2: Physical network values (lengths) will be stored as observations with source units recorded in metadata until a length unit code is added to units.py.

data_gaps: DoR SSRN statistics (all editions) - road length by pavement type, province, condition method; no register lead existed before r1.
Transaction-based time-release study for Birgunj/Biratnagar (none located; 04A also reports gap).
Per-TEU inland haulage and handling tariffs (rail container operator tariffs, trucking rates) by route and year.
NITDB annual throughput by ICD, rail vs road.
Official status documents for Raxaul-Kathmandu and Kerung-Kathmandu railways (DPR/feasibility dates).
Length unit (km) is absent from src/economic_model/units.py; road/rail length observations cannot be typed yet.
Primary records (DoR, BIPAD, customs) of the reported 2026 Trishuli-basin flood damage.

assumptions.text: Reference shipment: one import TEU East Asian hub -> Birgunj ICD, shared with 21B/05C.
Lengths stored with source units in metadata until units.py supports length.

challenges.text: units.py lacks a length unit (km); road, rail and transmission-line lengths (06A, 05A, 13A) cannot be recorded with a valid unit code. Request a 'km' unit in a new 'length' dimension via the catalog/config owners.

Route cost ownership: 06A records the inland (port-to-ICD) leg and physical constraints; 21B owns the route matrix incl. ocean leg. Please reference 06A-L08/L13 components rather than re-deriving them to avoid double counting.
Lead 06A-L01 (DoR SSRN) supplies the 'Department of Roads SRN layer (no lead yet)' needed in 13A exposed_assets; GIS layer availability still to confirm.
The Kolkata-Biratnagar rail service (reported July 2026) should remain a scenario hook, not a baseline change, until confirmed by NITDB/customs traffic records.

uncertainty: Entirely unquantified in r1. Main uncertainties: (i) road condition data vintage and method (IRI vs visual) may differ between DoR and donor assessments; (ii) door-to-port costs vary strongly by season, direction (import vs empty return) and mode, and survey-based LPI measures are not comparable with transaction data; (iii) rail project status changes with bilateral announcements that are frequently not followed by financing; (iv) 2026 flood damage in the Trishuli basin is unverified.
